/**
 * Codec debugging utilities for inspecting byte layouts.
 *
 * - `describe(codec)`         static byte-layout summary from the codec alone.
 * - `annotate(codec, bytes)`  per-region table showing what each byte means.
 * - `inspect(codec, value)`   `encode` + `annotate` in one call.
 * - `layout(codec, bytes)`    structured `LayoutNode` tree for programmatic use.
 * - `slots(codec, bytes)`     flat leaf list (the table backing `annotate`).
 */
import { encode, reader } from './io.ts'
import * as L from './lib/index.ts'
import type { Codec } from './types.ts'

// ---------------- Public API ----------------

/** Static byte-layout summary from `codec` alone (no value, no bytes). */
export function describe(codec: Codec.Type<any>): string {
  return describeNode(codec, '', []).join('\n')
}

/** Decode `bytes` through `codec` and pretty-print the per-region table. */
export function annotate<T>(codec: Codec.Type<T>, bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  const { root, bailedAt } = walk(codec, bytes)
  const all = flatten(root)
  const last = all[all.length - 1]
  const consumed = last ? last.offset + last.size : 0
  const rows: string[][] = [
    ['offset', 'size', 'hex', 'path', 'type', 'value'],
    ...all.map((x) => [
      hexOffset(x.offset),
      String(x.size),
      formatHex(bytes, x.offset, x.size),
      formatPath(x.path) || '·',
      x.type,
      formatValue(x.value),
    ]),
  ]
  const trailer =
    `\n\n${all.length} region${s(all.length)}, ${consumed}/${bytes.length} byte${s(bytes.length)}` +
    (consumed < bytes.length ? ` (${bytes.length - consumed} unconsumed)` : '')
  const bail = bailedAt
    ? `\n\nFAILED at ${formatPath(bailedAt.path) || '·'} (offset ${bailedAt.offset}): ${bailedAt.value}`
    : ''
  return formatTable(rows) + trailer + bail
}

/** Encode `value` with `codec`, then annotate the resulting bytes. */
export function inspect<T>(codec: Codec.Type<T>, value: T): string {
  return annotate(codec, encode(codec, value))
}

/** Decode `bytes` through `codec`, returning the hierarchical layout tree. */
export function layout<T>(codec: Codec.Type<T>, bytes: Uint8Array): layout.Node {
  return walk(codec, bytes).root
}

/** Flat leaf-region list: same data as `layout` but with composites elided. */
export function slots<T>(codec: Codec.Type<T>, bytes: Uint8Array): slots.Slot[] {
  return flatten(walk(codec, bytes).root)
}

// ---------------- Types ----------------
export namespace slots {
  /** A single byte region: a slice of the buffer that maps to one decoded value. */
  export type Slot = {
    /** Path from the root codec, e.g. `['user', 'scores', 0]`. */
    path: (string | number)[]
    /** Byte offset within the input buffer. */
    offset: number
    /** Number of bytes consumed. */
    size: number
    /** Decoded value (`undefined` for padding / unused bytes). */
    value: unknown
    /** Codec `label` (e.g. `'u8'`, `'lpUtf8'`, `'struct'`). */
    type: string
  }
}

export namespace layout {
  /** Slot augmented with `children` for composite codecs; leaves omit `children`. */
  export type Node = slots.Slot & { children?: layout.Node[] }
}

type Path = (string | number)[]
// ---------------- Codec introspection ----------------

const label = (c?: L.Codec.Type<any>): string | undefined => (c as unknown as L.Codec.Labeled<string>)?.label

const codecLabel = (c: L.Codec.Type<any>): string => {
  const lab = label(c)
  if (lab === 'literal' && 'value' in (c as any)) return `literal(${formatValue((c as any).value)})`
  return lab ?? '<unlabeled>'
}

const sizeLabel = (c: L.Codec.Type<any>): string =>
  c === L._varint ? '1–5 bytes' : L.is.sized(c) ? `${c.s} byte${s(c.s)}` : 'dynamic'

const isTagField = (v: any): boolean => (label(v) === 'literal' || label(v) === 'constant') && 'value' in v

/** First literal-tagged field of a struct variant — names the path segment for `tagged`. */
const variantTag = (variant: L.Codec.Type<any>): string | number | undefined => {
  if (label(variant) !== 'struct') return undefined
  for (const v of Object.values((variant as any).shape as Record<string, any>)) if (isTagField(v)) return v.value
  return undefined
}

/** Static byte size of the first tag-shaped (literal/constant) field on a struct variant. */
const firstTagFieldSize = (variant: L.Codec.Type<any>): number => {
  if (label(variant) !== 'struct') return 0
  for (const v of Object.values((variant as any).shape as Record<string, any>)) if (isTagField(v)) return v.s ?? 0
  return 0
}

// ---------------- Static describe ----------------

// Per-label child enumeration — drives the recursive tree drawing. Labels missing
// from this table render as leaves (sized, cstr, optional, nullable, typed, union,
// scalars, varint, utf8, lpUtf8, literal). `lazy` is transparent at walk time but
// shown explicitly here so describe-time output mirrors the codec's structure.
const kidsOf: Record<string, (cc: any) => Array<[string, L.Codec.Type<any>]>> = {
  struct: (cc) => Object.entries(cc.shape),
  tuple: (cc) => (cc.shape as L.Codec.Type<any>[]).map((v, i) => [`[${i}]`, v]),
  array: (cc) => [[`× ${cc.shape.size}`, cc.shape.item]],
  list: (cc) => [
    ['length', cc.shape.len],
    ['items × N', cc.shape.item],
  ],
  lazy: (cc) => [['<lazy>', cc.shape.inner]],
  framed: (cc) => [
    ['length', cc.shape.lc],
    ['inner', cc.shape.inner],
  ],
  padded: (cc) => [['inner', cc.shape.inner]],
  keyed: (cc) => [
    ['tag', cc.shape.tag],
    ...Object.entries(cc.shape.variants as Record<string, L.Codec.Type<any>>).map(
      ([k, v]) => [`'${k}'`, v] as [string, L.Codec.Type<any>],
    ),
  ],
  tagged: (cc) => [
    ['tag', cc.shape.tag],
    ...(cc.shape.variants as L.Codec.Type<any>[]).map((v, i): [string, L.Codec.Type<any>] => {
      const tv = variantTag(v)
      return [`variant ${tv !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(tv) : `#${i}`}`, v]
    }),
  ],
}

// `stack[i]` is true when level i is the last sibling at that depth — used to pick │/├/└ glyphs.
const describeNode = (c: L.Codec.Type<any>, name: string, stack: boolean[]): string[] => {
  const indent = stack
    .slice(0, -1)
    .map((last) => (last ? '   ' : '│  '))
    .join('')
  const branch = stack.length === 0 ? '' : stack[stack.length - 1] ? '└─ ' : '├─ '
  const head = `${indent}${branch}${name ? `${name}: ` : ''}${codecLabel(c)} (${sizeLabel(c)})`
  const kids = kidsOf[label(c) ?? '']?.(c) ?? []
  return [head, ...kids.flatMap(([n, child], i) => describeNode(child, n, [...stack, i === kids.length - 1]))]
}

// ---------------- Byte walker ----------------

const PADDING = '<padding>'
const UNUSED = '<unused>'

/** Sentinel returned by `visit` when a dynamic decode failure bubbles up. */
const BAIL = Symbol('walk_bail')
type Bail = typeof BAIL
const isBail = (v: unknown): v is Bail => v === BAIL

const errMsg = (e: unknown): string => (e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e))

/**
 * Walk `codec` against `bytes`, catching decode failures as `type: 'error'` slots.
 * Sized failures recover (advance to slot end, continue siblings); dynamic failures
 * bail out and surface the deepest error site in `bailedAt`.
 */
const walk = <T>(codec: Codec.Type<T>, bytes: Uint8Array): { root: layout.Node; bailedAt?: slots.Slot } => {
  const r = reader(bytes)
  const out: layout.Node[] = []
  const result = visit(codec, r, [], out)
  const root = out[0]!
  if (!isBail(result)) return { root }
  // Deepest error slot = bail site.
  const all = flatten(root)
  for (let i = all.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (all[i]!.type === 'error') return { root, bailedAt: all[i]! }
  return { root }
}

/** Execute `fn` with `r.end` temporarily restricted to `end`. */
const inFrame = <T>(r: L.Codec.Reader, end: number, fn: () => T): T => {
  const saved = r.end
  r.end = end
  try {
    return fn()
  } finally {
    r.end = saved
  }
}

/** Append a filler slot (padding / unused) covering `[r.pos, end)` if any, and advance `r.pos`. */
const fillTo = (r: L.Codec.Reader, end: number, kids: layout.Node[], path: Path, seg: string, type: string) => {
  if (r.pos >= end) return
  kids.push({ path: [...path, seg], offset: r.pos, size: end - r.pos, value: undefined, type })
  r.pos = end
}

/** Decode a leaf codec, emitting a `type: 'error'` slot on failure. */
const leaf = (c: L.Codec.Type<any>, r: L.Codec.Reader, path: Path, out: layout.Node[], start: number): unknown => {
  try {
    const value = c.d(r)
    out.push({ path, offset: start, size: r.pos - start, value, type: codecLabel(c) })
    return value
  } catch (e) {
    const sized = L.is.sized(c)
    out.push({ path, offset: start, size: sized ? c.s : r.pos - start, value: errMsg(e), type: 'error' })
    if (!sized) return BAIL
    r.pos = start + c.s
    return undefined
  }
}

type Walker<C = any> = (cc: C, r: L.Codec.Reader, path: Path, kids: layout.Node[], start: number) => unknown

// Walks `c` against `r`, appending one `LayoutNode` per visited codec to `out`.
// Leaves push a flat slot; composites recurse via the `composites` dispatch table.
// `lazy` is transparent — the inner codec's node replaces lazy in the tree.
const visit = (c: L.Codec.Type<any>, r: L.Codec.Reader, path: Path, out: layout.Node[]): unknown => {
  const start = r.pos
  const lab = label(c)
  if (!L.is.shape(c)) return leaf(c, r, path, out, start)
  if (L.is.lazy(c)) return visit((c as any).shape.inner, r, path, out)
  const handler = composites[lab as keyof L.ShapeCodecKindMap]!
  const node: layout.Node = { path, offset: start, size: 0, value: undefined, type: lab!, children: [] }
  const result = handler(c as any, r, path, node.children!, start)
  node.size = r.pos - start
  if (!isBail(result)) node.value = result
  out.push(node)
  return result
}

// Per-label composite walkers. Each returns the decoded value (which becomes
// `node.value`) or `BAIL` on dynamic failure — in which case the outer `visit`
// pushes the partial node with whatever children were accumulated so far.

const composites: { [K in keyof L.ShapeCodecKindMap]: Walker<L.ShapeCodecKindMap[K]> } = {
  'typed.array': (cc, r, path, kids, start) => {
    return leaf(cc, r, path, kids, start)
  },
  'typed.struct': (cc, r, path, kids, start) => {
    return leaf(cc, r, path, kids, start)
  },
  literal: (cc, r, path, kids) => {
    return visit(cc.shape.value, r, path, kids)
  },
  constant: (cc, r, path, kids) => {
    return visit(cc.shape.inner, r, path, kids)
  },
  lazy: (cc, r, path, kids) => {
    return visit(cc.shape.inner, r, path, kids)
  },
  transform: (cc, r, path, kids) => {
    return visit(cc.shape.inner, r, path, kids)
  },
  struct: (cc, r, path, kids) => {
    const o: any = {}
    for (const k of Object.keys(cc.shape)) {
      const v = visit(cc.shape[k]!, r, [...path, k], kids)
      if (isBail(v)) return BAIL
      o[k] = v
    }
    return o
  },
  tuple: (cc, r, path, kids) => {
    const sh = cc.shape as L.Codec.Type<any>[]
    const o: any[] = new Array(sh.length)
    for (let i = 0; i < sh.length; i++) {
      const v = visit(sh[i]!, r, [...path, i], kids)
      if (isBail(v)) return BAIL
      o[i] = v
    }
    return o
  },
  array: (cc, r, path, kids) => {
    const { item, size } = cc.shape
    const o: any[] = new Array(size)
    for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
      const v = visit(item, r, [...path, i], kids)
      if (isBail(v)) return BAIL
      o[i] = v
    }
    return o
  },
  list: (cc, r, path, kids) => {
    const { item, len } = cc.shape
    const n = visit(len, r, [...path, 'length'], kids)
    if (isBail(n)) return BAIL
    const o: any[] = new Array(n as number)
    for (let i = 0; i < (n as number); i++) {
      const v = visit(item, r, [...path, i], kids)
      if (isBail(v)) return BAIL
      o[i] = v
    }
    return o
  },
  framed: (cc, r, path, kids) => {
    const { inner, lc } = cc.shape
    const n = visit(lc, r, [...path, 'length'], kids)
    if (isBail(n)) return BAIL
    const end = r.pos + (n as number)
    return inFrame(r, end, () => {
      const v = visit(inner, r, path, kids)
      if (isBail(v)) return BAIL
      fillTo(r, end, kids, path, UNUSED, 'unused')
      return v
    })
  },
  padded: (cc, r, path, kids, start) => {
    const end = start + cc.s
    return inFrame(r, end, () => {
      const v = visit(cc.shape.inner, r, path, kids)
      if (isBail(v)) {
        // padded is sized — recover by skipping to slot end and surface partial node.
        r.pos = end
        return undefined
      }
      fillTo(r, end, kids, path, PADDING, 'padding')
      return v
    })
  },
  keyed: (cc, r, path, kids, start) => {
    const { variants, tag } = cc.shape
    const keys = Object.keys(variants)
    const tagStart = r.pos
    const before = kids.length
    const idx = visit(tag, r, [...path, 'tag'], kids)
    if (isBail(idx)) return BAIL
    if ((idx as number) >= keys.length) {
      kids.length = before // replace success slot with error
      kids.push({
        path: [...path, 'tag'],
        offset: tagStart,
        size: r.pos - tagStart,
        value: `keyed: tag index ${idx} out of bounds [0, ${keys.length})`,
        type: 'error',
      })
      return BAIL
    }
    const k = keys[idx as number]!
    const v = visit(variants[k]!, r, [...path, k], kids)
    if (isBail(v)) return BAIL
    if (L.is.sized(cc)) fillTo(r, start + cc.s, kids, path, PADDING, 'padding')
    return { [k]: v }
  },
  tagged: (cc, r, path, kids, start) => {
    const { variants, tag } = cc.shape
    const firstTagS = firstTagFieldSize(variants[0]!)
    const tagStart = r.pos
    const before = kids.length

    // literal tag (s=0): a separate index byte is written, walk it as a slot.
    // constant tag (s>0): the variant struct emits the tag itself — peek to find the variant.
    let idx: number
    let tagValue: unknown
    if (firstTagS === 0) {
      const ti = visit(tag, r, [...path, 'tag'], kids)
      if (isBail(ti)) return BAIL
      idx = tagValue = ti as number
    } else {
      try {
        tagValue = tag.d(r)
      } catch (e) {
        kids.push({ path: [...path, 'tag'], offset: tagStart, size: r.pos - tagStart, value: errMsg(e), type: 'error' })
        return BAIL
      }
      r.pos = tagStart
      idx = variants.findIndex((va: any) => Object.values(va.shape).some((l: any) => l?.value === tagValue))
    }
    if (!variants[idx]) {
      kids.length = before
      kids.push({
        path: [...path, 'tag'],
        offset: tagStart,
        size: firstTagS === 0 ? r.pos - tagStart : firstTagS,
        value:
          firstTagS === 0
            ? `tagged: tag index ${idx} out of bounds [0, ${variants.length})`
            : `tagged: unknown tag value ${JSON.stringify(tagValue)}`,
        type: 'error',
      })
      return BAIL
    }
    const variant = variants[idx]!
    const seg = variantTag(variant) ?? idx
    const v = visit(variant, r, [...path, seg], kids)
    if (isBail(v)) return BAIL
    if (L.is.sized(cc)) fillTo(r, start + cc.s, kids, path, PADDING, 'padding')
    return v
  },
}

// ---------------- Internals ----------------
const flatten = (n: layout.Node, out: slots.Slot[] = []): slots.Slot[] => {
  if (!n.children || n.children.length === 0) out.push(n)
  else for (const c of n.children) flatten(c, out)
  return out
}

// ---------------- Formatting ----------------
const s = (n: number): string => (n === 1 ? '' : 's')

const hexOffset = (n: number): string => `0x${n.toString(16).padStart(4, '0')}`

const formatHex = (bytes: Uint8Array, offset: number, size: number, max = 12): string => {
  const end = Math.min(offset + size, offset + max, bytes.length)
  const hex = Array.from(bytes.subarray(offset, end), (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(' ')
  return size > max ? `${hex} …` : hex
}

const formatPath = (path: Path): string =>
  path.map((seg, i) => (typeof seg === 'number' ? `[${seg}]` : i === 0 ? seg : `.${seg}`)).join('')

const formatValue = (v: unknown): string => {
  if (v === undefined) return '—'
  if (v === null) return 'null'
  if (typeof v === 'string') {
    const j = JSON.stringify(v)
    return j.length > 40 ? j.slice(0, 39) + '…"' : j
  }
  if (typeof v === 'bigint') return `${v}n`
  if (typeof v === 'number' || typeof v === 'boolean') return String(v)
  if (v instanceof Uint8Array) return `Uint8Array(${v.length})`
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return `Array(${v.length})`
  return `<${(v as any)?.constructor?.name ?? 'object'}>`
}

const formatTable = (rows: string[][]): string => {
  const widths = rows[0]!.map((_, i) => rows.reduce((m, r) => Math.max(m, r[i]!.length), 0))
  const fmt = (row: string[]) => row.map((cell, i) => cell.padEnd(widths[i]!)).join('  ')
  const sep = widths.map((w) => '─'.repeat(w)).join('  ')
  return [fmt(rows[0]!), sep, ...rows.slice(1).map(fmt)].join('\n')
}
